title: Full graph-wide direct and finite-field elliptic index-calculus measurements
status_note: Every-vertex preparation and a checked projected subgroup base are implemented. Controls and pilot passed audits, and a separately bounded all-vertex survey has launched (first 12 vertices: 192 attempts, 119 verified, 58 exhausted, 15 timeouts). This full matrix remains draft: exact representation registration, finite-field backends and qualified resource pilot remain open.
question: How do complete cold index-calculus costs and relation yields vary across every vertex and conductor stratum, on exact matched subgroup targets?
decision_value: The full coverage ledger will distinguish variation by model and conductor from missing or censored runs, determine whether a factor-base or oracle change improves the verified IC baseline, and identify implementation limits of finite-field routes without inferring results for unrun vertices.

resources.notes: Proposed worker envelope, not provisioned or estimated from measurements. Cost pilot and retained-record storage estimate are prerequisites; original large A/C/D/E storage is a separate unresolved requirement.

outputs.result_schema: Draft: sealed ecbench records, exclusive phase costs, complete native-counter inventory and independent replay receipts

cairn.notes: This full-matrix card is not published, leased or scheduled. The separate bounded survey is real local execution. Its resume ledger does not imply that this qualified full-matrix card has launched. run.argv requires a preplanned full campaign and intentionally refuses until the original gates are satisfied.

funding.rationale: Draft has no costed runnable protocol, so no queue priority or posted reward yet. A reviewer sets funding against the existing 131072-1000000 seed-card range when ready.
